body:
## What it does

Pulls from Edmunds, KBB, CarGurus and Cars.com to find where the discount against list price is actually largest, rather than what is advertised locally. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @dannymacias shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
